name: 夕阳再现-炎龙20141231
english_name: Sunset Reappears: Fire Dragon Edition (2014-12-31 Build)
english_description: The most expanded surviving build in the genuine Sunset Reappears map lineage (shared with this project's xyzxfk, xyzxfy2, xyzx, jhfy3, and xajh4gkb): the same core jianghu map has been extended with overseas regions in Japan (d/japan/) and Korea (d/gaoli/) plus an auto-mapping feature (d/automap/) not present in its siblings. A file-level comparison confirms it shares ~93-94% of its common-path world files byte-for-byte with both xyzxfk and xyzxfy2, so this is the same authored map carried forward rather than a rewrite. It also layers on its own distinctive character-creation step (choosing one of eleven schools of magic after stat allocation), a custom wizard rank ladder running all the way up to "(boss)"/"(ceo)", and support for multiple client protocols (ZMud/ToMud).
